sm_top.sm: A ballistic missile attack struck Terminal 4 at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, prompting international condemnation.
UAE officials confirmed that a Flydubai co-pilot planned a suicide attack on Tel Aviv.
Houthi mortar shelling targeting homes in Taiz killed a child and injured a woman.
North Korea launched a ballistic missile into the East Sea.
Airstrikes and explosions were reported in the Yemeni capital of Sanaa, targeting Sanaa airport.
An unknown projectile hit a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz.
Houthi forces launched missile and drone attacks targeting Aden airport.
An attack on Riyadh airport caused a fire and injuries, raising the death toll to 13.
Allegations of Eritrean troop incursions into Tigray deepened the rift with Ethiopia, threatening regional peace.
Reports emerged of maritime security incidents and vessels struck by projectiles in the Gulf region.
Yemeni government forces repelled a Houthi attack near Bab el-Mandeb in Taiz.
Ukrainian drone strikes crippled multiple Yandex data centers in Russia, significantly reducing Russian disinformation bot traffic.
Coalition forces launched large-scale airstrikes against Houthi targets across Yemen, including in Hodeidah and Taiz.
An RSF drone strike killed 41 people in Sudan's Blue Nile region, according to a rights group.
The aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln returned to San Diego following a combat deployment.
Mali announced the recapture of Kidal without a fight.
Ukrainian drone strikes hit oil facilities in Russia's Samara Region, causing large fires.
Saudi coalition retaliates against Houthi attacks with airstrikes following strikes in Riyadh.
Russian bombs hit apartment buildings in Sloviansk, injuring nine people.
At least 71 people were killed in intercommunal clashes in Rumbek, South Sudan.
Reports note that Israeli military actions in Gaza continue despite announcements of a ceasefire.
Airstrikes hit Sanaa and its airport in Yemen.
Russian forces launched a mass missile and drone attack across Ukraine, killing at least 16 to 20 people.
Airstrikes at a gold mine near the Sudan-Egypt border killed dozens of miners.
A Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia killed at least 20 people.
The Arab coalition intercepted and destroyed a drone in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province.
US forces disabled a cargo ship attempting to breach the Iranian blockade in the Gulf of Oman.
Ethiopian troops recaptured the regional capital of Tigray, prompting promises of administrative change.
A Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia killed at least 20 people, including children.
A migrant boat capsized off the coast of Djibouti, leaving 109 dead and 116 missing.
Yemeni government military forces report advancing against the Houthis, claiming 1,150 Houthi fighters killed over the past 24 hours.
Israeli airstrikes continued across Gaza, resulting in eight reported deaths.
Russian forces strike Kyiv's energy infrastructure as reports emerge of an energy ceasefire claim by Trump.
Yemen's Houthis claimed attacks on Dammam airport and Aramco sites.
Reports indicated 41 people were killed in a paramilitary drone strike in Sudan near the Ethiopian border.
A Ukrainian drone attack knocked out about 70% of the Volgograd Oil Refinery's primary processing capacity, damaging three units and suspending operations.
A Russian strike on a residential building in Zaporizhzhia caused casualties and prompted rescue operations.
Fighting in Yemen intensified, resulting in 63 deaths within 24 hours.
A congressional report indicates that 81 US aircraft have been lost or damaged during operations in the Iran conflict.
Antiwar.com reported that Saudi airstrikes in Yemen killed at least 66 civilians and wounded 90 in September.
